about.label: About
about.title: A Bit About Me
about.intro: I'm originally from Tashkent, Uzbekistan. After years managing teams and chasing corporate targets, I came to Vietnam to volunteer—and accidentally discovered I loved teaching way more than hitting quarterly KPIs. So I stayed.

story.title: My Background
story.p1: I'm a bit of a language nerd (I speak 7 languages, though some are definitely better than others). I'm TESOL and PGCE certified, currently working on my Master's, and I believe in always learning. Honestly, my students teach me something new every week.
story.p2: When I'm not teaching, I'm usually reading, lifting weights, or grappling. Staying active keeps me sharp—and keeps up with energetic students!
story.p3: From ILA Vietnam to BlueSky Kindergarten and 15+ schools across Ho Chi Minh City, I've worked with every type of learner imaginable.

classroom.title: Why My Classroom
classroom.description: Here's the thing: I keep my groups small (max 10 students). Not because I'm exclusive, but because I've seen what happens in those 25-student language center classes or 50-student school rooms—you barely get to speak. My home classroom in Phú Nhuận has CCTV security, separate restroom, air conditioning, and mosquito-killing lamps. It's comfortable, safe, and designed for focused learning.
classroom.address: Golden Mansion 1, 119 Phổ Quang, Phú Nhuận

philosophy.title: How You'll Learn
philosophy.description: And yes, you'll actually speak English. A lot. That's kind of the whole point. Through real conversations, engaging activities, and practical scenarios, you'll build confidence naturally—because the best way to learn a language is to speak it, not just study it.

q1.question: Where are classes held?
q1.answer: Golden Mansion 1, 119 Phổ Quang, Phú Nhuận. I also teach at students' homes in Phú Nhuận, Gò Vấp, and Bình Thạnh.

q2.question: What ages do you teach?
q2.answer: Young Learners (6-10), Teens (11-17), and IELTS/exam prep for all ages.

q3.question: How much do lessons cost?
q3.answer: It depends on program type, location, and frequency. Reach out for a straight answer—no hidden fees.

q4.question: Do you teach only group classes?
q4.answer: Yes. All classes are group-based (max 10 students), including online sessions, so everyone gets speaking practice.

q5.question: What are your qualifications?
q5.answer: TESOL and PGCE certified. I've also completed my DELTA (Cambridge) and am awaiting results. Taught at ILA Vietnam, BlueSky Kindergarten, and 15+ schools.

q6.question: Can I try a class first?
q6.answer: Yes! Free assessment session—no pressure, no obligation.

q7.question: Why small groups instead of large classes?
q7.answer: In a 25-person class, you barely speak. With max 10 students, you actually practice.

q8.question: Is your classroom safe for kids?
q8.answer: Absolutely. CCTV security, separate restroom, air-conditioned rooms, and mosquito-killing lamps. Safe, comfortable, and parent-approved.
